tables: CREATE TABLE "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "settings_rows" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"))
CREATE TABLE "cache_entries" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"))

CREATE TABLE "playback_positions" ("release_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "episode_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("release_id", "episode_id"))

CREATE TABLE "stream_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "release_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "episode_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "quality" INTEGER NOT NULL, "headers_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "watch_entries" ("release_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "episode_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "release_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "episode_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "poster_url" TEXT NULL, "episode_ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "is_watched" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_watched" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("release_id", "episode_id"))

CREATE TABLE "downloaded_episodes" ("release_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "release_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "episode_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "poster_url" TEXT NULL, "episode_ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "downloaded_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "stream_quality" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("release_id", "episode_id"))
